analysis.one_line_summary: A creator demonstrates curling and styling her front bangs into a sleek swoop using a pink flat iron, finishing with a full bouncy curled ponytail look.
analysis.full_description: A vertical social media beauty video set to an R&B track. A young woman in a beige robe clamps a wide front hair section with a light-pink flat iron, rotates it, and glides it down to form a smooth spiral curl. She then uses a fine comb to shape her front hair into a sculpted, retro side swoop while perfecting the curl. Finally, she poses and turns to showcase her complete glamorous half-up ponytail with voluminous bouncy curls, styled baby hairs, and blows a kiss to the camera.

scenes.visual: Young woman in a waffle robe clamping her front hair strand with a light pink styling iron, twisting it around the plates, and pulling it downwards.
scenes.action: Curling a wide front section of hair with the heated iron.

scenes.visual: The finished spiral curl falls into place. The creator takes a fine-tooth comb to sweep and smooth the front roots into a clean side-swoop.
scenes.action: Combing the styled front hair and shaping the side swoop curl.

scenes.visual: Creator touches and displays her finished half-up ponytail, turns her head to show the curl definition from the back and side, and smiles at the camera.
scenes.action: Showing off the finished hairstyle, turning around, and blowing a kiss.

hook.first_frame: Creator looking into camera/mirror while clamping a thick section of front hair into a pink flat iron.
hook.visual_0_3s: Creator rotating the pink styling tool and beginning to glide it through her hair.
hook.pattern_interrupt: Immediate, satisfying close-up hair styling action right at the start.

narrative_beats: Curling bang section with the styling iron
Combing and sculpting the side-swoop fringe
Full hair reveal and posing with finished curls
key_claims: Easy to style polished retro swoop bangs
pain_points: Struggling to curl front bangs smoothly without harsh kinks

talent.hair_before: Dark brown hair tied in a high half-up ponytail with curled ends, front fringe straight and ready for styling
talent.hair_after: Voluminous curled ponytail with glossy sculpted retro side bangs and styled edges

audio_and_edit.ending: Creator blows a kiss towards the camera while showing the finished hairstyle.

analysis.notes: No spoken audio or text overlays present; video relies entirely on visual demonstration and background music.
